definition: Hugo Larochelle is a research Scientist at Google DeepMind and Co-inventor of Denoising Autoencoders & NADE.
details: Pioneered autoregressive generative modeling (NADE), denoising autoencoders, meta-learning, and accessible online deep learning lectures.

explainer.lead: Hugo Larochelle is a machine learning researcher. His work spans machine learning.

timeline.what: Doctor of Philosophy, Université de Montréal
